verdicts.reason: A stacks the logo, bag, headline and CTA evenly down the tall canvas and keeps the brand intact. Its flaws: the headline breaks into 'Garden-fresh / fizz', leaving one orphaned word, and the CTA sits a little too close under the headline. B makes the bag bigger but leaves a wide empty gap above the headline, then crowds the headline and a shrunken CTA into the bottom edge. Its olive circle nearly touches the CTA button, and the headline runs almost to both side edges.
